title: Plumeform reveal (v2)
description: A wrapper that fades its content in as it scrolls into view: opacity 0 to 1, a 22px rise and a 6px blur clearing, driven by the scroll itself (CSS view timeline). Give list items a step number to stagger them.
notes: CSS only: browsers without scroll-driven animations, and reduced motion, show the content in place
don't put it inside an overflow-hidden box (use overflow-clip), or the timeline freezes
name: plumeform-v2-reveal

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (div by default; li inside lists)

props.name: step
props.description: position in a staggered row: 0, 1, 2… each arrives a little later
